name: cassava
description: Image dataset for classifying cassava leaf diseases; it measures model performance on identifying disease type from leaf images. Designed to benchmark image classification methods for agricultural disease diagnosis, it emphasizes robustness to real-world field image variability. Typical use is training and evaluating convolutional and transformer-based vision models for multi-class plant disease recognition.
reputation: Widely used Kaggle-derived dataset for benchmarking plant-disease classification models; popular in academic and applied ML communities for agricultural vision tasks.
